adventure_drops_multiplier_check.name: adventure_drops_multiplier_check
adventure_drops_multiplier_check.value: ("adventure_drops"."category" IN ('item', 'material') AND "adventure_drops"."multiplier_percent" IS NULL) OR ("adventure_drops"."category" NOT IN ('item', 'material') AND "adventure_drops"."multiplier_percent" >= 100)

exercise_reward_days_value_consistency_c.name: exercise_reward_days_value_consistency_check
exercise_reward_days_value_consistency_c.value: ("exercise_reward_days"."has_value" = 1 AND "exercise_reward_days"."observed_value" IS NOT NULL) OR ("exercise_reward_days"."has_value" = 0 AND "exercise_reward_days"."observed_value" IS NULL)

health_days_value_check.name: health_days_value_check
health_days_value_check.value: ("health_days"."has_value" = 1 AND "health_days"."steps" IS NOT NULL) OR ("health_days"."has_value" = 0 AND "health_days"."steps" IS NULL)
